notes: Tonkeeper wallet. Per tonkeeper.helpscoutdocs.com/article/123, no one from the Tonkeeper team will ever contact you first. Impersonation cluster commonly uses *_support and *_official suffixes.
Telegram's first-party crypto wallet bot (@wallet). Common impersonation: *_support, *_help.

Fragment (fragment.com) is the TON username and gift marketplace. Fragment does NOT have a Telegram support bot — all support is via the website. p05h documented the 'FragmentOffersRoBot' (capital B) impersonation.
Binance has NO official Telegram support presence per their FAQs 360001153311 and 360020555572. Any Binance-named Telegram entity is impersonation.
Coinbase explicitly states it has no Telegram support presence (Coinbase security blog: 'Anatomy of a Telegram Scam'). Named impersonator handles include @Leocrypto22 and @CBSupportchat.
TON Foundation maintains blog.ton.org/how-to-stay-safe-on-ton-and-telegram. Common impersonation: '*_foundation' bots claiming staking/airdrop campaigns.
Notcoin Mini App / token. Real bot is @notcoin_bot.
MetaMask is a browser/mobile extension wallet, NOT a Telegram bot. Any MetaMask-named Telegram entity is impersonation.
Trust Wallet themselves published a write-up on Telegram-malware impersonation campaigns using fake influencer accounts.
Phantom is a Solana wallet. Kaspersky documented a 2,000% surge in fake 'wallet verifier' bots late 2024.
Real bot is @SafeguardRobot. The 'OfficialSafeguardBot' impersonation campaign is well-documented.
Ledger is a hardware-wallet brand. Any Telegram bot offering Ledger 'support' or 'recovery' is impersonation.
